key_insight: Constrained Allen–Cahn phase-field topology optimization boosts flexoelectric sensor voltage primarily by increasing mechanically induced source charge.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports performance-driven design of microscale flexoelectric devices while accounting for geometric manufacturing variations and structural connectivity.
method: Optimize material distribution using an infinitesimal-deformation continuum model and output voltage objective.
Account for manufacturing variations with a worst-case objective over prescribed geometric realizations.
Impose spectral constraints to preserve structural connectivity.
evidence_signal: Evaluations cover 2D pressure and bending sensors and a 3D thin-film device; nominal voltage gains reach approximately 4.8× for the pressure sensor and 2.5–3.4× for the bending sensors.
watch_item: Experimental validation and integration with specific microfabrication processes remain necessary to establish practical device performance.
paper_title: Constrained Allen-Cahn phase-field topology optimization of flexoelectric devices
